reviews.title: Scammed and Charged Non Consensual Subscription
reviews.text: I signed up far a 3-days free trial and made sure to cancel on the same day like an hour later yet got charged with a year subscription plan for 49.99$. When I tried to contact their support team for them to cancel my pending payment no help or solution was received, they keep pushing the problem onto the Apple support team when the charged was shown as non-refundable on the Apple website.
reviews.reply: Dear customer, hello there! Your feedback is the best way to improve our service, so we greatly appreciate it. We're sorry to hear about your experience with the free trial. We understand how frustrating it can be when things don’t go as expected. The free trial should not have resulted in a charge if canceled within the trial period. By referring to the article below, you will understand the situation comprehensively, including relevant explanations: https://help.answers-365.com/hc/en-us/articles/24483470601745-I-have-been-charged-instead-of-3-days-trial-on-Nebula-app. Please reach out to us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com again, and we’ll do everything we can to assist you directly. We also recommend contacting Apple Support to check the refund status, as they handle subscription payments on their platform. Thank you for your patience, and we hope to resolve this for you soon. Have a nice day, Nebula team 🔮
